evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: Irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage of femoral trochela and patella and medial femoral condyle and mild subchondral bone marrow edema, reflecting grade 3-4 chondromalacia
evidence.PF OA: Irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage of femoral trochela and patella
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis
evidence.Contusion: mild subchondral bone marrow edema, reflecting grade 3-4 chondromalacia
